principle: Visible features, source role, semantic meaning, archive provenance, and theory status are independent dimensions.

geometry.coiled_coil: one helical/coiled structure wound around another carrier or paired coil
geometry.braid: multiple strands with repeated over/under or intertwined ordering
geometry.triplet: three visually grouped strands/components without asserting braid topology
geometry.linked_rings: two or more closed linked loops
geometry.hopf_like: two-ring visual resembling a Hopf link; descriptive resemblance only unless topology is established
geometry.borromean_like: three-ring visual resembling a Borromean arrangement; descriptive resemblance only unless topology is established
geometry.toroidal_coil: coil arranged around a toroidal or annular carrier
geometry.recursive_coil: coil/spring whose carrier is itself curved/coiled
geometry.superhelix_like: visually higher-order helical wrapping; does not by itself establish project ᚼ semantics
geometry.plane_intersection: curve/strand visibly meets, crosses, or passes through a plane/sheet
geometry.curved_sheet: curved surface/sheet is a major object

composition.profile_left: profile/face motif occupies or faces from left side; requires face/profile detector or human label
composition.profile_right: profile/face motif occupies or faces from right side; requires face/profile detector or human label
composition.facing_pair: two face/profile motifs oriented toward one another
composition.split_field_vertical: image field divides principally left/right into distinct visual populations
composition.split_field_horizontal: image field divides principally top/bottom into distinct visual populations
composition.multi_panel: multiple distinct panels/axes in one image
composition.symmetry_bilateral: approximate mirror organization about one axis
composition.crop_variant: cropped view of a larger/source image

palette.red_bw: predominantly grayscale with red accent; source-backed early podcast palette lineage
palette.rgb_triplet: red/green/blue used to distinguish three strands/components
palette.cyan_magenta_split: spatially segregated cyan/blue and magenta/red fields

role.provenance_notebook: photograph/scan of source notebook or handwritten provenance
role.model_diagram: diagram illustrating a project model or construction
role.comparison_plot: plot whose primary role is comparison between quantities/models/states
role.simulation_random: explicitly random or Monte Carlo simulation display
role.mock_method_demo: explicitly mock/synthetic demonstration of a method
role.external_inspiration: outside reference supplied as shape/style inspiration, not project evidence
role.generated_visualization: generated/rendered project visual rather than documentary source image

status.current: current project material at catalog time
status.superseded: retained for history but replaced by later formulation
status.method_demo: demonstrates a method rather than a physical result
status.semantic_label_unknown: visible class is clear but intended thematic meaning is unresolved

provenance.source_backed: tag/meaning directly supported by source text, caption, or Nathan label
provenance.visible_fact: descriptive fact visible in the image
provenance.machine_measured: feature produced by deterministic image measurement
provenance.archive_neighbor: relationship inferred from directory/page adjacency only

hard_boundaries.WEIRD_WACKY_4D_ORGANISM: excluded from public gallery under standing policy
hard_boundaries.external_inspiration: may train shape vocabulary but must not become project evidence
hard_boundaries.thumbnail_path: GO by default only subject to stronger explicit exclusion/quarantine
hard_boundaries.square_heuristic: square + clearly project-related may suggest thumbnail role, never overrides stronger policy
